SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, o.warehouse_id, o.order_date, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.audit_time, o.close_time, o.create_time, c.code AS customer_code, c.name AS customer_name, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM sal_order o LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT d.id, d.order_id, d.material_id, d.qty, d.price, d.amount, d.out_qty, d.remark, (d.qty - d.out_qty) AS remaining_qty, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec FROM sal_order_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_order SET status = 10, audit_time = NOW(), audit_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sal_order SET status = 90, close_time = NOW(), close_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (status IN (10, 20) OR (status = 0 AND wf_started = 1))
UPDATE sal_order_detail SET out_qty = out_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderDetailId} AND deleted = 0 AND out_qty + #{qty} <= qty

UPDATE sal_order SET status = 30, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN (10, 20) AND deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sal_order_detail d WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.out_qty < d.qty )

UPDATE sal_order SET status = 20, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 10 AND deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sal_order_detail d WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.out_qty > 0 )

mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.actual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN d.actual_cost ELSE d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0) END), 0) AS costAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.amount - CASE WHEN d.actual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN d.actual_cost ELSE d.qty * COALESCE(m.ref_cost, 0) END), 0) AS profitAmount, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS totalQty FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY o.out_date ORDER BY o.out_date
